name: Transcription Pipeline Template
description: Flex Template for the Audio Transcription Pipeline (Dataflow).

parameters.name: input_subscription
parameters.label: Input Subscription
parameters.helpText: Full path of the ordered Pub/Sub subscription to read from (e.g. projects/your-project/subscriptions/raw-audio-sub).

parameters.name: output_topic
parameters.label: Output Topic
parameters.helpText: Full path of the Pub/Sub topic to publish transcribed text to.

parameters.name: canonical_audio_bucket
parameters.label: Canonical Audio Bucket
parameters.helpText: GCS bucket for storing clean, stitched or pre-segmented audio. If omitted, binary output is skipped.

parameters.name: max_transmission_duration_ms
parameters.label: Max Transmission Duration (MS)
parameters.helpText: Absolute limit on continuous transmission duration.

parameters.name: route_to_dlq
parameters.label: Route to DLQ
parameters.helpText: If false, exception bubbles immediately instead of Pub/Sub DLQ.

parameters.name: dlq_topic
parameters.label: DLQ Topic
parameters.helpText: Pub/Sub topic to route Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ) processing failures.

parameters.name: bypass_stitching
parameters.label: Bypass Stitching
parameters.helpText: If true, bypasses stateful stitching and treats each audio chunk as a complete transmission.
